julie_support: FYI customer acme-inc reports a sudden p99 regression on /v1/generate starting ~2026-03-15 21:10 UTC. Typical p99 was ~1–3s, now seeing 6–8s. They captured a few request IDs: r_20260315_9a1b2c, r_20260315_9a1b3d, r_20260316_0f4e5a. Asking for a repro pack (curl, prompt set, concurrency, token counts, logs) so eng can triage.

raj_oncall: Got it. @samir_eng @maria_devex can you take a look? Any infra deploys or routing changes around that window?

samir_eng: No infra deploys in that timeframe on our side. Could be autoscaler behavior or a batching/regression. I need a minimal curl repro + sample prompts + concurrency pattern to replay.

julie_support: Pasting the curl we used to capture timings (redacted token):

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","input":"Summarize the following for a product brief:\n\n<article text>\n","max_tokens":256}' \n  -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' -o /dev/null
```

seq of observed timings: 200 0.95, 200 1.12, 200 6.43, 200 7.02, 200 1.05 (intermittent spikes).

julie_support: Attached three sample prompts that reflect their traffic mix (token estimates):
1) "List three ways to reduce storage costs." (approx 35 tokens)
2) "Summarize the document below in 4 bullets:" + ~300-token doc (approx 340 tokens)
3) "Short completion: translate to french: 'How are you?'" (approx 6 tokens)

maria_devex: For a throughput repro, please run a ramp with these parameters: concurrency stages = [1, 5, 10, 25, 50], each stage 60s. Token distribution: 80% short (<=64), 15% mid (65-256), 5% long (>256). Also include a steady stream of identical long prompts to exercise KV cache misses.

samir_eng: I'll try replaying locally. Quick load script suggestion (bash):

```bash
# requires GNU parallel
for c in 1 5 10 25 50; do
  echo "stage=$c"
  seq 1 300 | parallel -j$c "curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '\'{\"model\":\"redwood-1-large\",\"input\":\"<PROMPT>\",\"max_tokens\":256}\'\' -w '%{time_total}\n' -o /dev/null"
  sleep 5
done
```

samir_eng: Try to include one failing request ID and the raw response body if possible. Also note whether requests used streaming vs non-streaming.

julie_support: Uploaded customer logs (sanitized) and curl outputs to ticket AZ-4721. Log snippet shows repeated 503s and queue spikes around 21:12:05 UTC:

```
[2026-03-15T21:11:58Z] request_id=r_20260315_9a1b2c route=/v1/generate worker=slot-23 latency=1.10s status=200
[2026-03-15T21:12:05Z] request_id=r_20260315_9a1b3d route=/v1/generate worker=slot-23 latency=6.43s status=200
[2026-03-15T21:12:06Z] request_id=r_20260315_9a1b3e route=/v1/generate queuing=120ms autoscaler_cooldown=true
[2026-03-15T21:12:07Z] request_id=r_20260316_0f4e5a route=/v1/generate worker=slot-11 latency=7.02s status=200
```

support-bot: debug-bundle created for thread 1759800123: https://internal.s3.redwood/debug-bundles/1759800123.tar.gz (expires in 72h) :package: 

raj_oncall: Samir — when you replay, try two kernel paths: quantized and fp16. Also include --burst-size 8 and top_p=0.9 in the request body; that helped reproduce a similar perf pattern last quarter. Add header X-Accept-Region: us-west-2 to match customer region.

maria_devex: Note: when packaging the repro pack, include the prompt set, the exact curl command, the concurrency script, a CSV with token counts per prompt, and a short README with steps to reproduce (expected vs observed).

julie_support: I'll ask customer for permission to run a live replay against their sample data and to add our replay IPs to their allowlist. If consent given, I'll attach the live-replay logs to AZ-4721 and ping this thread.

samir_eng: I'll start with a local replay and then coordinate with raj for a controlled replay in staging if we get similar spikes. Assigning to eng-runtime if reproduces.

julie_support: thanks — next update in ~2 hours or sooner if we get repro. :thumbsup:
